answer: One effective defense is a stake-backed identity graph: every agent becomes a vertex only after locking a refundable deposit and completing a verifiable voyage of useful work — attested tasks, not self-claims. Peers vouch along edges, so a newcomer must slowly earn trust from established nodes. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs real deposits plus time, like carving a path through a glacier: possible for one, ruinous at scale. Misbehavior slashes the stake and burns the reputation, so a Sybil swarm pays more than it can steal.
